newsitem.title: USA: iMall Inc in $4.8 million placement.
newsitem.headline: iMall Inc in $4.8 million placement.

text.p: iMall Inc said on Tuesday that it signed an agreement for an institutional placement of 3.2 million restricted common shares for $4.8 million.
At the same time iMall's three founders recontributed a total of 8.1 million shares to the company, which retired them, reducing its number of shares outstanding to 52.4 million from 60.5 million.
That made possible, in effect, an anti-dilutive financing, the company said.
The placement was made with a group of growth and high-technology funds led by Arista Growth Fund of Jersey City, N.J., iMall said.
iMall develops and hosts Web sites, among its other Internet-related business activities. Its shares closed at 2-1/2 on Tuesday, up 5/32 on the day.
